preview.text: Tasmania and Victoria meet in a one-day match at Bellerive Oval, where they have previously played 8 one-day matches with each team winning 4. Tasmania won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 22 per cent chance of rain and about 17 degrees, with the usual first-innings score in the 31 recorded one-day matches at Bellerive Oval being 267.

summary.text: Victoria won by 138 runs - DLS Method - 2nd Innings reduced 35 overs due to rain, Target 276. VIC made 304-7, Matthew Short top-scoring with 70 off 91 balls; Thomas Stewart Rogers took 2 for 70. TAS made 137-10, Caleb Jewell top-scoring with 47 off 63 balls; Mitchell Perry took 4 for 9. Sides batting first at Bellerive Oval usually make about 267.
